data.long_meaning: The name Bert is derived from the Old English word 'beorht,' meaning bright or shining. This name was common in medieval Europe and was borne by numerous saints, including St. Bert of Lindsey and St. Bert of Bourges. The name Bert carries the meaning “Bright, shining” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English. Parents who choose Bert usually hope their child will grow to embody bright, shining and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bert total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
